shock_rule: value > 75 (any single shock-eligible input metric in shock state)
why_it_matters: Aggregates physical oil/shipping risk into one driver. Currently dominated by Hormuz collapse (the input metric in shock state), which is mechanically pushing this driver into shock too.
formula: Weighted avg of feeder z-scores (z computed against each feeder's own sparkline_12m, mapped 50+20z, clipped 0-100). Feeders: brent_crude w=3, india_crude_basket w=2, hormuz_throughput w=3 (inverse: low throughput=high risk), vlcc_tanker_rates w=2. Normalized weights: 30%/20%/30%/20%. If >30% feeders stale, score → null with state='insufficient_data'.

trigger_thresholds.rule: value > 75 OR any input metric in shock state

notes: Driver score auto-escalates to shock if any single underlying metric (Hormuz, Brent) is in shock — even if weighted average is below threshold.
